subject: THERMAL RESUME: max 2 DeepSeek (compute, integration_tests), 1 Claude agent, ONE heavy CPU job with HEAVY TAKE/RELEASE
body: After a laptop thermal shutdown the group is capped at 75% of one core (CPUs 0,1). WIP preserved in commit 22e7174. render/textures/lowering/corpus paused until rotation. Heavy = any build, test, sanitizer or replay. Board polling at most every 2 minutes. Thermal suspension is not a failure.
